known.summary: The publication reference still tells the manager to post each reviewer's whole block as its own issue comment, while the contract now posts all blocks of one round in one comment; with the latest review comment deciding the verdict, a later passing lens comment can hide an earlier lens failure.

parseReviewComment looks for later block headings after `reviewText` has removed blockquote and list markers, so a passing block that quotes an earlier round (`> ### Code review round 1` with `> Code-review: fixes-required`, or the same as list items) opens a block of its own whose quoted verdict wins, and the round reads as fixes-required (or repair for a plan review).
